kv_attention.k_write_granularity: four QK-compatible packed words per token and head
kv_attention.qk_matrix_source: Product KV_READ K buffer in QK-compatible Matrix-B K-transpose order
kv_attention.future_token_slots: initialized sentinel; masked by causal softmax

dma_weight_streaming.mode: one AXI4 DMA transaction per initialized matrix weight tensor
dma_weight_streaming.completion_fence: DMA done/status checked before CMDQ publication

layer_manifests.preload_mode: host AXI-Lite fixture initialization; excluded from command_cycles

formats.embedding_position: signed INT32 container of selected INT8 values
formats.LayerNorm gamma: canonical signed INT8 gamma multiplied by 1024 to Q0.15
formats.Matrix input: signed INT8 packed tile-A, arithmetic shift 0
formats.Requant: arithmetic right shift then signed INT8 saturation; no rounding bias
formats.LM logits: 16 physical N=16 GEMM tiles stored tile-major; Host may assemble each valid token row

limitations: Selected token embedding rows are fixture-loaded; Top has no embedding lookup opcode.
Pseudo-weights are deterministic, not pretrained GPT-2 weights.
Only four nonzero token rows are executed in 16-row physical tiles.
layer_manifests.runtime_checkpoint_scope: active sequence rows only (4 of 16); padded query rows are unspecified scratch and are not model outputs
layer_manifests.final_golden_scope: active residual2_i32 rows only (4 of 16) for inter-layer handoff
layer_manifests.output_initialization: AXI-Lite clear of padded Matrix-A query words using 4x4-subtile physical addresses after Q projection and clear of each 16x16 Q15 causal-softmax output before its first producer; runtime padding initialization only, no computed tensor backfill
